uganda-kenya-great-rift.lead: The Mara’s Migration plains and the source of the Nile in one journey, finishing in a suite suspended over the Kalagala Rapids.

reasons.d: A stay at Angama Mara or Mara Plains Camp on the Oloololo Escarpment, with champagne sundowners as the plains turn gold and herds cross the Mara in season.

reasons.t: A balloon, then a bush breakfast
reasons.d: A dawn balloon over the Mara River with hippos, crocodiles and elephants below, followed by a gourmet breakfast in the open savannah.
Lemala Wildwaters Lodge’s suites hang over the Kalagala Rapids on a private rainforest island, with a private speedboat to the historic source of the Nile and rare shoebill storks.

uganda-secrets-north-volcanic-lakes.lead: Uganda away from the usual route: Kidepo’s isolated valleys, glittering crater lakes and chimpanzees in the Kibale canopy.

reasons.d: Cheetahs, leopards, ostriches and vast buffalo herds with no other visitors, and a rocky-ridge sundowner at Apoka Safari Lodge as lions survey the Narus Valley plains.

reasons.t: A balloon over the Narus Valley
reasons.d: A dawn balloon with the Morungole Mountains rising behind, followed by a farm-to-table breakfast in the open Kidepo savannah.
A champagne brunch over turquoise Lake Nyinambuga, chimpanzee tracking in Kibale with an elite primatologist, and shoebill storks at the Bigodi Wetland.

uganda-source-nile-wildwaters.lead: A river journey: the true source of the Nile by private boat, jet-boating the white water, and a lodge built over the rapids.

reasons.d: A private speedboat to the John Speke monument, crowd-free, at the exact point where the Nile begins.
Lemala Wildwaters Lodge’s canvas-and-thatch suites stand on wooden decks over the Kalagala Rapids, with a bonfire dinner on an open deck above the thundering water.
A dawn balloon over the Victoria Nile basin with a champagne brunch beside a rapid, then a jet-boat safari through white-water channels past shoebill storks and hippos.

ultimate-mara-lodge-hopper.lead: Seven days, two superb Mara positions: a clifftop lodge above the Mara Triangle, then leopard country on the Talek River.

reasons.d: Angama Mara overlooks the Mara Triangle, where strictly managed vehicle numbers and exceptional predator density make for intimate sightings, with sundowners on the Oloololo clifftop.

reasons.t: A balloon and a kopje lunch
reasons.d: A dawn balloon with a champagne breakfast on landing, then a private lunch on the granite kopjes with the reserve spread out below.
JW Marriott Mara Lodge, a five-star lodge on the Talek River opening onto central Mara and leopard country, with a night drive and a Maasai cultural immersion.

ultimate-tanzania-luxury-circuit.lead: Tanzania’s northern circuit in comfort, opened by a morning in Nairobi National Park and closed with four nights at Grumeti River Lodge.

reasons.d: A private morning game drive in Nairobi National Park, with the city skyline behind lion and rhino, before you cross into Tanzania.

reasons.t: Elephants, tree-climbing lions and the crater
reasons.d: Three nights at Nimali Tarangire among large elephant herds, Lake Manyara’s tree-climbing lions and flamingo shores, and a full day in the Ngorongoro Crater from &Beyond Ngorongoro Crater Lodge.
A scenic bush flight to the Serengeti and four nights at the exclusive Grumeti River Lodge.

untamed-sanctuaries.lead: Southern and western Tanzania, far from the northern crowds: Ruaha’s lion prides, the Rufiji by boat and chimpanzees in the Mahale Mountains.

reasons.d: Lion prides of twenty or more, wild dogs, leopards and cheetah, with four nights at Jabali Ridge, eight suites on a rocky kopje in a private concession where night drives are allowed.
A walking safari with an armed ranger in Ruaha, a balloon over the Great Ruaha River at dawn, and a boat safari on the Rufiji River in Nyerere.

reasons.t: An hour a day with chimpanzees
reasons.d: Two full permits in the Mahale Mountains, spending an hour each day with habituated wild chimpanzees from Greystoke Mahale.

zimbabwe-granite-castles-wild-valleys.lead: Matobo’s balancing granite boulders and rhino on foot, then Singita Pamushana’s private 130,000-acre reserve.

reasons.d: Tracking highly protected white rhinos on foot with expert armed rangers, metres away and in safety.
Breakfast inside a natural granite rock amphitheatre ringed by balancing boulders, and sunset cocktails at World’s View as black eagles soar.
Singita Pamushana’s 130,000 private acres offer crowd-free Big Five viewing, a pontoon cruise with champagne breakfast and a telescope tour of the night sky.

zimbabwe-legendary-wildlife-waterfalls.lead: Victoria Falls, Hwange’s elephants at eye level and a canoe on the Zambezi: Zimbabwe’s wild side in ten days.

reasons.d: A private walking tour of the Falls, one of the Seven Natural Wonders, and a champagne sunset cruise on the Zambezi among hippos and crossing elephants.
An underground photographic bunker at Linkwasha puts you inches from drinking elephant bulls, and a sunrise balloon floats over Hwange’s vlei plains.
A private full-day apex predator track in Hwange for wild dogs, lions and leopards, then a canoe safari down the Zambezi’s quiet channels.

zimbabwe-secret-wilderness-ancient-empir.lead: Great Zimbabwe’s medieval ruins, elephants on their hind legs at Mana Pools and a pontoon through Kariba’s drowned forests.

reasons.d: A private guided tour of the Great Zimbabwe UNESCO ruins, with the medieval walls turning gold at sunset over vintage wines.
Walking alongside Mana Pools’ elephant bulls as they stand on their hind legs for albida pods, a behaviour unique to the area, with a breakfast cooked over open coals.

reasons.t: Water, from the air and the lake
reasons.d: A doors-off helicopter flight over Mana Pools’ channels, and a sunset pontoon cruise among Lake Kariba’s drowned forests with champagne and canapés.
